A post DETAIL with preview, publish metadata, engagement counts, comments panel and audit history. COMMENT MODERATION: view, search, order, reply as the official LGU account, hide, delete with confirmation, restore, and disable/enable comments per post. NO AI moderation and NO sentiment analysis.
